items_flat.title_en: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by over 20% for three months
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將GPT-5.6 Sol API與點數定價下調逾20%，為期三個月
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it is dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next three months. The reduction applies to the API and eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex credit plans; Pro, Plus and Business subscription usage limits remain unchanged.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布未來三個月將GPT-5.6 Sol的API與點數定價下調逾20%。降價適用於API及符合條件的ChatGPT Work與Codex點數方案；Pro、Plus與Business訂閱的使用上限維持不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The temporary cut lowers the cost of frontier agent and coding workloads on the flagship model without altering subscription caps, potentially accelerating high-volume iteration while OpenAI competes on price-performance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這項暫時性降價降低旗艦模型在代理與編碼工作負載上的成本，卻不更動訂閱上限，可能加速高用量迭代，同時強化OpenAI在性價比上的競爭力。
items_flat.quote: As we continue to push the frontier of capabilities while improving efficiency, we're dropping API and credit pricing of GPT-5.6 Sol by over 20% for the next 3 months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著我們持續推進能力邊界並提升效率，我們將GPT-5.6 Sol的API與點數定價在未來3個月下調逾20%。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands Claude Mythos 5 defensive access via Claude Security and partners
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic透過Claude Security與合作夥伴擴大Claude Mythos 5防禦存取
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Mythos 5 is now available in Claude Security for Enterprise customers to scan codebases and suggest patches, is being integrated into partners’ cyber tools, and launched a $35 million Defender Advantage Fund for organizations building defensive cyber capabilities.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布Claude Mythos 5現已在Claude Security中提供給企業客戶掃描程式碼庫並建議修補，正整合至合作夥伴的網路安全工具，並推出3500萬美元的Defender Advantage Fund支持防禦性網路能力建設。
items_flat.analysis_en: By routing Mythos 5 through constrained product interfaces rather than direct model access, Anthropic aims to scale defensive cyber capability while containing dual-use risk. Real-world uptake and partner integration depth will determine impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Anthropic選擇透過受限產品介面而非直接模型存取來部署Mythos 5，意圖在擴大防禦能力的同時控制雙重用途風險。實際採用率與合作夥伴整合深度將決定影響。
items_flat.quote: Claude Mythos 5 is now available in Claude Security, and coming soon to partners' cyber defense tools. We're also launching a $35M fund to help secure open-source software.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Mythos 5 現已可用於 Claude Security，並即將整合至合作夥伴的網路防禦工具。我們也推出 3500 萬美元基金協助強化開源軟體安全。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing compatible with Zero Data Retention
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI預覽與零資料保留相容的Private Safety Processing
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a preview of Private Safety Processing for Zero Data Retention (ZDR) customers on frontier models. The system aims to detect patterns of misuse across multiple interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布為零資料保留（ZDR）客戶在前沿模型上預覽Private Safety Processing。該系統旨在跨多次互動偵測濫用模式，同時不讓OpenAI人員存取底層內容。
items_flat.analysis_en: This attempts to reconcile enterprise privacy demands with the need for multi-turn safety monitoring as agents grow more capable. Real-world effectiveness and customer uptake will determine whether the approach scales.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉試圖在企業隱私需求與代理能力提升後的多輪安全監控需求之間取得平衡。實際效果與客戶採用率將決定此方法能否擴展。
items_flat.quote: Private Safety Processing is designed so we can continue to offer ZDR.
items_flat.quote_zh: 私密安全處理的設計是為了讓我們能繼續提供ZDR。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Bot expanded to SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+ and Teams plans
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Bot擴展至SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+與Teams方案
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced Grok Bot is now included with SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, Cursor Ultra and all Cursor Teams plans, plus a limited free trial for other users. Bots run on their own cloud computers and can execute multi-step jobs across tools.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI宣布Grok Bot現已包含於SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+、Cursor Ultra及所有Cursor Teams方案，其他用戶可享有限免費試用。Bot在自己的雲端電腦上運行，可跨工具執行多步驟工作。
items_flat.analysis_en: Wider plan inclusion lowers the barrier to persistent agent teammates and tightens the product feedback loop for xAI’s agent roadmap, though enterprise waitlisting signals controlled scaling.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣的方案納入降低持續性代理隊友的使用門檻，並強化xAI代理路線圖的產品回饋迴路，但企業仍採等待名單顯示控管擴張節奏。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot is now included with all SuperGrok Plus, Cursor Pro+, and Cursor Teams plans.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot現已包含於所有SuperGrok Plus、Cursor Pro+與Cursor Teams方案。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6現已上架Google Enterprise Agent Platform
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced Grok 4.6 is available via Google’s Enterprise Agent Platform / Model Garden. The model offers a 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels, priced at $2 / $6 per million input/output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI宣布Grok 4.6已透過Google Enterprise Agent Platform / Model Garden提供。該模型支援50萬token上下文與可配置推理等級，定價為每百萬輸入／輸出token 2美元／6美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Adding Google’s enterprise platform alongside existing Bedrock availability expands multi-cloud options for agent workloads and intensifies competition among frontier models on major cloud marketplaces.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在Bedrock之外再上架Google企業平台，擴大代理工作負載的多雲選擇，並加劇主要雲市集上前沿模型的競爭。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 is now available on Google Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6現已於Google Enterprise Agent Platform提供。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches AI Futures strategic blog on concentration-of-power risks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出AI Futures策略部落格，聚焦權力集中風險
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published the inaugural post of its new Strategic Futures team blog, AI Futures. The piece, by Dean Ball, frames concentration of power as the largest long-run risk from transformative AI and outlines principles for preserving individual and institutional agency.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布新成立的Strategic Futures團隊部落格AI Futures的首篇文章。作者Dean Ball將權力集中視為轉型AI最大的長期風險，並勾勒保全個人與機構能動性的原則。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is OpenAI’s most explicit public framing yet of structural political-economy risks beyond technical safety. It signals a shift toward longer-horizon institutional thinking, though concrete policy proposals remain limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是OpenAI迄今最明確公開框架技術安全之外的結構性政經風險。它顯示轉向更長視野的制度思考，但具體政策提案仍有限。
items_flat.quote: how should free society be restructured to preserve individual rights and agency while accommodating the emergence of transformative AI?
items_flat.quote_zh: 自由社會應如何重組，以在容納變革性AI出現的同時，保全個人權利與能動性？

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Ads expands to 31 European markets
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT廣告擴展至31個歐洲市場
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT Ads to 31 European countries next week, including Germany, France, Spain and Italy. Ads remain limited to Free and Go users; paid plans stay ad-free.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI將於下週把ChatGPT廣告擴展至31個歐洲國家，包括德國、法國、西班牙與義大利。廣告仍僅限Free與Go用戶；付費方案維持無廣告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move accelerates monetization of the free tier while testing European regulatory and user acceptance. It also broadens the geographic base for advertiser demand data.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉加速免費層級的貨幣化，同時測試歐洲監管與用戶接受度，並擴大廣告主需求數據的地理基礎。
items_flat.quote: Next week, ChatGPT Ads will expand to 31 European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Austria.
items_flat.quote_zh: 下週，ChatGPT廣告將擴展至31個歐洲國家，包括德國、法國、西班牙、義大利、瑞典、挪威、丹麥、荷蘭與奧地利。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The model supports a 500k context window and configurable reasoning levels, priced at $2 / $6 per million input/output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI宣布Grok 4.6已於Amazon Bedrock全面提供。該模型支援50萬token上下文與可配置推理等級，定價為每百萬輸入／輸出token 2美元／6美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bedrock availability lowers the barrier for AWS-centric enterprises to trial Grok 4.6 alongside other frontier models, intensifying multi-cloud competition for agent workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Bedrock上架降低AWS為主企業試用Grok 4.6的門檻，並加劇代理工作負載的多雲競爭。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們很高興宣布Grok 4.6已在Amazon Bedrock正式上線。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Build expands to web and mobile on every plan
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Build擴展至網頁與行動端，適用所有方案
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI made Grok Build available on web and mobile for every plan. The coding agent previously required desktop or specific access paths.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI讓Grok Build在所有方案的網頁與行動端皆可使用。此編碼代理先前需桌面或特定存取路徑。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader surface availability increases everyday usage of Grok’s agent tooling and tightens the feedback loop for iterative improvements that Elon Musk has publicly emphasized.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣的使用介面增加Grok代理工具的日常使用，並強化Elon Musk公開強調的迭代改進回饋迴路。
items_flat.quote: Grok Build is now available on every plan, on the web and on mobile.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Build現已在所有方案的網頁與行動版上線。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk highlights near-daily Grok Build improvements
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk強調Grok Build近乎每日改進
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that improvements to Grok Build continue almost every day, linking to the product page after a detailed community changelog on subagent speed, workflow UX and multitasking.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk發文表示Grok Build的改進幾乎每天持續，並連結產品頁，此前社群已詳細更新子代理速度、工作流程UX與多工。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cadence underscores xAI’s focus on agent reliability over pure benchmark leaps. Sustained daily polish may matter more for real productivity than occasional large model drops.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此節奏凸顯xAI優先代理可靠性而非純基準跳躍。持續每日打磨對實際生產力的影響可能大於偶發的大型模型發布。
items_flat.quote: Improvements to Grok Build almost every day
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Build幾乎每天都有改進

xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that improvements to Grok Build continue almost every day, linking to the product page after a detailed community changelog on subagent speed, workflow UX and multitasking.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk發文表示Grok Build的改進幾乎每天持續，並連結產品頁，此前社群已詳細更新子代理速度、工作流程UX與多工。
xai.analysis_en: The cadence underscores xAI’s focus on agent reliability over pure benchmark leaps. Sustained daily polish may matter more for real productivity than occasional large model drops.
xai.analysis_zh: 此節奏凸顯xAI優先代理可靠性而非純基準跳躍。持續每日打磨對實際生產力的影響可能大於偶發的大型模型發布。
xai.quote: Improvements to Grok Build almost every day
xai.quote_zh: Grok Build幾乎每天都有改進

brief_en: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol API pricing >20% for three months. Anthropic expanded Claude Mythos 5 defensive access via Claude Security and a $35M fund. xAI broadened Grok Bot to more plans and added Grok 4.6 to Google’s Enterprise Agent Platform, while Elon noted near-daily Build polish.
brief_zh: OpenAI將GPT-5.6 Sol API價格下調逾20%為期三個月。Anthropic透過Claude Security擴展Mythos 5防禦存取並設立3500萬美元基金。xAI擴大Grok Bot至更多方案，並將Grok 4.6上架Google企業代理平台，Elon持續強調Build近乎每日改進。
